name: Ordo Labs
long_description:
Ordo lets regulated labs delegate analysis, quality checks and report drafting to AI agents. We turn each lab’s checking rules into workflows, with source-linked results for scientists to review and approve.

We have two paid pilots with labs in the US and Europe. Pilot results show 90%+ less time spent on post-analysis work.

Our ambition is to make lab software perform more of the work scientists currently do manually, expanding across analytical methods, report types and sites.

Agents do the work, scientists sign.
one_liner: Regulated lab software, rebuilt around AI agents

launches.title: Ordo Labs: The AI-native OS for regulated labs
launches.tagline: We help the labs behind your medicines deliver study results 10x faster.
launches.body:
Every medicine you've taken was tested in a regulated lab, where scientists still analyze data, check QC and write reports by hand. Ordo does that work for them. In **paid pilots in the US and Europe**, labs cut post-analysis time by **90%+**.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yiwjgTE4gfs>

**The problem** 

In regulated labs, every result must be traceable, every system validated and every change approved by QA. Generic AI tools can't meet that bar, so scientists at CROs and CDMOs still do most of this work manually.

**What Ordo does** 

Ordo brings lab data together, runs the analysis, checks results against each lab's own QC checklists, and drafts study reports with tables, figures and exact source references. Scientists and QA sign off on every result.

Compliance is built in from the start. Each lab gets its own deployment built to be validated, every decision is recorded, and updates reach production only after the lab's QA approves them.

**Where we're going** 

Every new workflow runs on the same validated foundation. The more a lab validates on Ordo, the more Ordo can run on its own, until it handles most of the daily scientific work in regulated labs.

**The team**

**Sebastian** was lead quantitative researcher at Handelsbanken, one of the largest Nordic banks. **Kristina** co-founded SecureTag, a pharma authentication platform piloted with Uganda's National Drug Authority. **Adam** co-founded Sakur, a software consultancy for YC companies and European fintechs, and led backend engineering at Careless, an AI-first UK insurance broker.

Advised by lab executives and shaped by interviews with 100+ scientists.

**Run a GxP-regulated lab? Email us at [founders@ordolabs.ai](mailto:founders@ordolabs.ai).** We'd love to show you Ordo.
